# Mihu AI

Mihu AI provides workspace APIs for building and operating AI agents across voice, messaging, customer engagement, automation, and analytics.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mihu-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get Call Analytics** (read-only): Return authoritative aggregate call counts, duration, outcomes, handling, and cost for a required half-open time window.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Retrieve one existing asynchronous task when its UUID is already known from another Mihu AI response.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Return the connected Mihu AI workspace identity, locale, timezone, and wallet balance.
- **List Agents** (read-only): List workspace agents, optionally filtered by lifecycle status or searched by text.
- **List Appointments** (read-only): List appointments filtered by schedule, contact, status, or date range.
- **List Calls** (read-only): List calls filtered by agent, call status, or inbound/outbound/web direction.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List one page of campaigns, optionally searched by name or description and filtered by lifecycle status.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Search and filter workspace contacts by identity, status, channel, pipeline, campaign, tag, pool, or creation date.
- **List Conversations** (read-only): Find conversations by contact, exact or partial phone, agent, campaign, task, channel, status, or label.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): List one page of conversation sessions filtered by conversation, contact, agent, campaign, task, status, or text/voice type.
